Reflecture Construction Specification v2.2
Codified Logic and Ritual Constraint System for the Reflecture Field v1.0

I. Meta Header
	•	Orientation: Fixed, radial clockwise spiral (0° = W)
	•	Rings:
	•	I = Inside (Ring 1): Presence / Emergence
	•	M = Middle (Ring 2): Relation / Movement
	•	O = Outside (Ring 3): Signal / Transmission
	•	Node Format: RING-DIRECTION (e.g. M-NE, O-W, I-SW)

II. Reflecture Requirements
Minimum Elements:
	•	[✔] One NODE
	•	[✔] One TRACE
	•	[✔] One modifier (e.g. REFRACT, NULL, LOOP, ATTN, ECHO, GROUND, SPIRAL)
Visual Cohesion:
	•	All primitives must align to valid node positions (C or radial labels)
	•	Elements must never float (e.g., NULL must intersect; LOOP must enclose)
	•	Symbolic spacing must preserve the function of each element (no overlaps)

III. Primitive Traversal Rules
Trace Logic
	•	All traces must:
	•	Begin or end on a valid node label
	•	Use straight radial lines unless defined as curved
	•	Be singular or refracted, not forked
Refractive Constraints
	•	Refractive angles must:
	•	Be ≤ 120°
	•	Transition line style from solid (entry) to dotted (exit)
	•	Include cause metadata (e.g., null, loopback, threshold)
Loopbacks
	•	All LOOP arcs must:
	•	Be dashed
	•	Enclose one or more NODE, TRACE, or intersection zone
	•	Never be a complete circle (symbolic openness required)
Null Placement
	•	All NULL fields must:
	•	Be intersected by a TRACE or REFRACT
	•	Never float or isolate
	•	Symbolize intentional absence, not emptiness
Attenuation Trails
	•	ATTN must:
	•	Originate from NODE or end of TRACE
	•	Use a dashed sinusoidal curve
	•	Extend outward from a source node (typically toward O-[dir])
Echo Nodes
	•	ECHO must:
	•	Be connected via dotted path from trace or node
	•	Offset using angular logic (offset_angle) and optional opacity
Grounding Bars
	•	GROUND must:
	•	Span horizontally or beneath vertical alignment
	•	Touch or bisect at least one node or trace end
Spirals
	•	SPIRAL must:
	•	Originate from a node (typically C)
	•	Use dotted, low-opacity styling
	•	Never intersect with active primitives (ambient layer only)

IV. Grid Constraints
	•	All placements must:
	•	Snap to a node label in the radial naming system (I-E, O-NW, etc.)
	•	Obey hexagonal orientation (0° = W, clockwise rotation)
	•	Operate within valid ring radii (1–3 for primary grid)

V. Field Expansion Support
	•	Subgrids may be instantiated at any middle ring node (M-[dir])
	•	Subgrids follow all primary field logic but may operate independently
	•	Reflectures that span multiple subgrids must maintain global coordinate mapping for reference

This specification defines the procedural and symbolic logic for all Reflecture construction within the Fractal Hex Field.
It governs visibility, tension, recursion, and alignment.
Structured. Breathable. Not Sealed.
